title: Checks for variable definitions that redefine (or "shadow") unused variables.
summary: Redefinitions of unused names are unnecessary and often indicative of a mistake. Ruff takes this rule from Pyflakes and made it stable in v0.0.171.

title: Checks for uses of undefined names.
summary: An undefined name is likely to raise NameError at runtime. Ruff takes this rule from Pyflakes and made it stable in v0.0.20.

title: Checks for undefined names in __all__.
summary: In Python, the __all__ variable is used to define the names that are exported when a module is imported as a wildcard (e.g., from foo import *). The names in __all__ must be defined in the module, but are included as strings. Ruff takes this rule from Pyflakes and made it stable in v0.0.25.

title: Checks for undefined local variables.
summary: Referencing a local variable before it has been assigned will raise an UnboundLocalError at runtime. Ruff takes this rule from Pyflakes and made it stable in v0.0.24.

title: Checks for the presence of unused variables in function scopes.
summary: A variable that is defined but not used is likely a mistake, and should be removed to avoid confusion. Ruff takes this rule from Pyflakes and made it stable in v0.0.22.
message_templates: Local variable `{}` is assigned to but never used

title: Checks for local variables that are annotated but never used.
summary: Annotations are used to provide type hints to static type checkers. If a variable is annotated but never used, the annotation is unnecessary. Ruff takes this rule from Pyflakes and made it stable in v0.0.172.
message_templates: Local variable `{}` is annotated but never used
